16.issue_summary: The app creates Firebase and Google accounts and syncs a profile, but Settings has no deletion action, and the unused deletion screen only opens email or a web page.
16.evidence: auth_controller.dart line 191 calls FirebaseAuth.instance.signInAnonymously() during initialize, and lines 266-292 link or sign in with a Google credential and then call UserProfileSync.upsertCurrentUser(). settings_screen.dart lines 138-168 (Account section) only offer nickname editing and Login/Logout. Logout calls signOut() (auth_controller.dart lines 302-318), which signs out of Firebase and Google and removes local auth prefs (lines 418-425) but does not delete the user. AccountDeletionScreen (account_deletion_screen.dart lines 17-47) only launches a mailto to idoyun781@gmail.com or https://doyun0327.github.io/quotation/delete-account.html. No other Dart file references AccountDeletionScreen, and the auth and deletion code contain no Firebase user.delete() or other remote account-purge call.
16.recommendation: Add a discoverable control under Settings > Account that starts account deletion in the app and deletes remote records (Firebase Auth user deletion plus synced profile and cloud data). A mail draft, an external page, or signOut() does not by itself satisfy the in-app deletion requirement. Keep the public deletion URL for the Play Console data-deletion field.
